name: Nuxt
description: Nuxt 4 has an explicit filesystem architecture and enforceable app/server/shared boundaries.

rules.title: Use app/ for Vue application code
rules.summary: Nuxt 4 uses app/ as the main application directory and defines conventional subdirectories such as components, composables, layouts, middleware, pages, plugins and utils.

rules.title: Use server/ for Nitro server code
rules.summary: Nuxt server routes, APIs, middleware, plugins and server utilities belong under server/.

rules.title: Keep Vue app and Nitro server imports separated
rules.summary: Server routes/utilities must not import app-only Vue code, and app code must not import server-only code.

rules.title: Keep shared/ runtime-neutral
rules.summary: Code under shared/ is usable by both Vue and Nitro and therefore must not import Vue app or Nitro server code.

rules.title: Use layers for large modular/domain-oriented Nuxt applications
rules.summary: Nuxt layers are explicitly suitable for modular architectures, reusable UI/configuration and Domain-Driven Design in larger codebases.

sources.title: Nuxt Directory Structure v4
sources.notes: Defines the Nuxt 4 app, server, shared, layers, modules, public and test structure.

sources.title: server · Nuxt Directory Structure v4
sources.notes: Explicitly forbids mixing app-only Vue code and server-only Nitro code.

sources.title: shared · Nuxt Directory Structure v4
sources.notes: Defines shared code as runtime-neutral and states it cannot import Vue or Nitro code.

sources.title: layers · Nuxt Directory Structure v4
sources.notes: Documents layers for reusable code, separation of concerns, feature modules and DDD-style organization.
